# Security & RBAC Requirements Quality Checklist: Role-Based Access Control & Endpoint Authorization

**Purpose**: High-assurance requirements-quality review evaluating completeness, clarity, consistency, edge-case coverage, and testability of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and endpoint authorization requirements.  
**Created**: 2026-09-14  
**Feature**: [specs/007-role-endpoint-access/spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness: Privilege Boundaries & RBAC Scope

- [x] CHK001 - Are exact role permissions explicitly documented for every REST endpoint across all six microservices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 - Does the specification define whether callers with multiple assigned roles (e.g. `CUSTOMER` + `RESTAURANT_MANAGER`) receive the cumulative union of privileges? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the allowed HTTP methods explicitly enumerated for each protected path in `analytics-service`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the permission boundary for restaurant table inventory sub-resources (tables, combinations, opening hours) explicitly defined per HTTP verb? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK005 - Does the specification explicitly define a default-deny policy for any unlisted or future API endpoints? [Gap, Security Coverage, Spec §FR-012]

---

## 2. Requirement Clarity: Token Claims & Authority Mapping

- [x] CHK006 - Is the exact JWT claim path (`realm_access.roles`) specified for role extraction from Keycloak tokens? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Research §1]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the role authority prefixing convention (`ROLE_<role_name>`) unambiguously specified for Spring Security evaluation? [Clarity, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK008 - Does the specification explicitly state how client-level roles or custom scopes are handled if present in the token? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the expected behavior for tokens with missing, null, or empty `realm_access` claims explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 3. Requirement Consistency: Inter-Service & Multi-Role Rules

- [x] CHK010 - Are role definitions (`CUSTOMER`, `RESTAURANT_MANAGER`, `ADMIN`) consistent across all six domain services? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK011 - Do the permissions for reading restaurant catalog data align consistently between `restaurant-service` and `availability-service`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the distinction between restaurant-wide reservation querying (`GET /api/v1/reservations?restaurantId=...`) and individual booking lookup (`GET /api/v1/reservations/{id}`) consistent across user stories and functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK013 - Are the role constraints between joining the waiting list and claiming a cancellation offer consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, User Story 2]

---

## 4. Edge Case & Negative Flow Coverage: Token Validation & Security Controls

- [x] CHK014 - Are error response requirements specified when an unauthenticated request reaches a protected endpoint? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the distinction between HTTP 401 Unauthorized (unauthenticated or invalid token) and HTTP 403 Forbidden (authenticated but lacking role) explicitly required across all services? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK016 - Are dual-issuer validation requirements (`localhost:8081` vs `keycloak:8080`) explicitly specified to remain active under the `docker` profile? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK017 - Does the specification address expected response codes when an expired or malformed token is submitted to a role-protected endpoint? [Edge Case, Coverage]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the public accessibility (`permitAll`) of Swagger UI (`/swagger-ui/**`) and OpenAPI specs (`/v3/api-docs/**`) unambiguously documented to prevent accidental lockdown? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 - Are actuator health and readiness probe requirements specified to ensure container liveness is not broken by authentication filters? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 5. Acceptance Criteria & Measurability: Verification & Testability

- [x] CHK020 - Can the rejection of `customer1` on administrative endpoints be objectively measured with specific HTTP status codes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK021 - Can the rejection of pure `manager1` or `admin1` on reservation booking be objectively verified with HTTP 403? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK022 - Are automated slice test requirements (`WebApplicationContextRunner` or `@WebMvcTest`) specified for verifying authorization filters in isolation? [Acceptance Criteria, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the zero-regression criterion for asynchronous Kafka event publishing and table allocation algorithms measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

---

## 6. Documentation & Walkthrough Quality: README & Direct Ports

- [x] CHK024 - Does the specification clearly define the required documentation contents for the Role-Based Access Control matrix in `README.md`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, User Story 3]
- [x] CHK025 - Are the exact direct microservice port assignments (`8082`–`8087`) documented for every step in the interactive walkthrough? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK026 - Does the specification specify which seeded Keycloak user (`manager1` vs `customer1`) must be used for each step in the end-to-end walkthrough? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, User Story 3]
- [x] CHK027 - Are token acquisition instructions explicitly documented to show how curl commands obtain Bearer tokens via password grant? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## 7. Dependencies, Governance & Constitution Alignment

- [x] CHK028 - Does the specification preserve the Constitution's multi-module boundary rules without introducing leaky cross-service dependencies? [Constitution Principle II]
- [x] CHK029 - Are all Maven dependency additions (such as `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server` in `analytics-service`) validated against the root POM dependency management? [Constitution Principle II, III]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the requirement for clean reactor-wide verification (`mvn clean test`) documented as a quality gate before completion? [Constitution Principle V]
